## Context / Problem

Discovered from majestic-depilatory-beetle. The advisory `sweep (windows)` job deselects the 21 tests in `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/hardcoded-tmp.args` (runs at `b4e0d01b649`, 2026-11-15/16). Windows has no `/tmp`, so a literal `/tmp/...` path is the drive-relative `\tmp\...` there.

Root cause, confirmed from Windows job 133527199439 (run 43932173744):

- **Product defect.** `ensure_fresh` keeps its once-per-minute read-fetch throttle marker at the literal `f"/tmp/.ticket-sync-{md5}"` (`src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:198`, written at `reads.py:256`). On Windows that directory does not exist, so the marker read always fails (age 9999) and the write is swallowed: every read fetches, i.e. the throttle is off. 19 tests fail with `FileNotFoundError: ... '\\tmp\\.ticket-sync-<md5>'` because they stamp or read the same literal path (`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_close_fresh_ac_material.py:47`, `tests/unit/test_read_freshness_git_spawns.py:99`, `tests/unit/test_read_freshness_parity.py:139`).
- **Test-only.** `tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_sync_logger.py:171` and `tests/unit/test_child_hooks.py:55` compare `str(Path("/tmp/x"))` against the POSIX literal; Windows renders `\tmp\x`.

## Approach

Keep the marker in the platform temp directory, which is where the stdlib already puts per-host scratch: add `sync_marker_path(tracker_abs: str) -> str` in `src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py` returning `os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), f".ticket-sync-{md5[:12]}")`, used by `_sync_marker_age`. One function owns the path, so tests import it instead of rebuilding the literal. Also pass `encoding="utf-8"` on the marker read/write (`reads.py:200`, `reads.py:256`). No config key, env var or flag is added.

Every test that builds the marker literal switches to `sync_marker_path`: the three above plus `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py:152`, `tests/interfaces/store/sync_contention_harness.py:46` and `tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py:91` (on macOS `gettempdir()` is not `/tmp`, so these would silently stop clearing the real marker). The two test-only asserts compare against `str(Path("/tmp/x"))`. `docs/concurrency.md:943` and `docs/bash-migration.md:309` name the old path and are updated.

Portability: `tempfile.gettempdir()` and `os.path.join` resolve per platform; nothing POSIX-only is introduced.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py`
- `tests/unit/test_read_freshness_git_spawns.py`, `tests/unit/test_read_freshness_parity.py`, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_close_fresh_ac_material.py`, `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/sync_contention_harness.py`, `tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py`, `tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_sync_logger.py`, `tests/unit/test_child_hooks.py`
- new regression test `tests/unit/test_sync_marker_tempdir.py`
- `docs/concurrency.md`, `docs/bash-migration.md`
- `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/hardcoded-tmp.args` and its `@` line in `.github/workflows/test.yml` (both deleted once every line is fixed)

## Testing

- Regression (Linux gate, fails before the fix): with `tempfile.tempdir` monkeypatched to a `tmp_path` subdirectory, `sync_marker_path` lands inside it, and an `ensure_fresh` call inside the window spawns no git because the marker it wrote there is read back as fresh. Edge path: a missing marker still reports age 9999.
- The 21 listed tests pass under `make verify`.
- Windows: `gh workflow run test.yml --ref main` after merge; the `sweep (windows)` job runs the 21 tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The class's root cause is recorded on this ticket with the evidence that confirmed it.
- [x] `git grep -n '/tmp/.ticket-sync' -- src tests` prints nothing on the merged tree.
- [x] The new regression test fails on the pre-fix `reads.py` and passes after (both outcomes recorded in a comment).
- [x] Every line removed from `hardcoded-tmp.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [x] `sweep (windows)` concludes `success` on that run.
